C1440.title: Time Tells All: Deanonymizing Blockchain RPC Users with Zero Transaction Fees
C1440.summary: A 2025 study proposed a passive deanonymization method targeting blockchain RPC users. By comparing when an RPC service receives a request with when the corresponding transaction appears on the public ledger, an observer may link a user's network address to an on-chain pseudonym. The method sends no active blockchain transaction and therefore incurs no transaction fee; the paper evaluated it through modeling, ledger measurements, and real-world experiments.
